newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian bond tranche priced at average 91.07 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian bond tranche priced at average 91.07 pct.

text.p: A new two trillion rouble tranche of the two-year OFZ interest-bearing bond maturing in March 1998 was priced at an average 91.07 percent at an auction on Wednesday to yield an average 107.22 percent, the central bank said.
The average price of the bond when it was first issued on March 13, 1996, was 87.84 percent. On Tuesday the bond closed at 91.50 percent.

At the last auction of OFZ bonds on September 11, a new tranche of the 18-month issue maturing in February 1997 was priced at an average 95.25 percent to yield an average 83.08 percent. Full details of the auction follow.
Issue volume 2.00 trln rbls 3.50 trln rbls
The bond pays its next quarterly coupon on December 11. The coupon has been set at 149,788 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 60.08 percent, less accruals of 11,522,15 roubles.
On Wednesday the finance ministry will also repay six trillion roubles in a maturing six-month Treasury bill issue and is also offering 7.50 trillion roubles of six-month T-bills.
